messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] inference-runtime/pool-2 error-rate spike >5% over 1m. Paging oncall-sre
oncall-sre: I got the page, looking now. grabbing logs and checking routing.
oncall-sre: @marta are you around to help with KV/cache side? suspecting cache invalidation after the last quant rollout
marta: here. saw the alert. I can run quick checks. what model and rollout?
jonah: seeing a correlated spike with the 03:10 quantized build for model: rwd-7b-q4. Latency & 5xxs climb.
kenji: quick status: 3 nodes in pool-2 showing growing tail latency, one node 10% 500s. cpu/gpu ok, but kv cache miss rate jumped.
jonah: +1 to kv miss. metric: kv.cache.miss_rate = 0.42 -> 0.82 since 03:09 (graph link: https://grafana.redwood/kv/miss/237654)
marta: attempting targeted KV prefix flush on node-03, running dry-run first.
kenji: I'll open a fallback to fp16 model variant for the affected route. rolling to rwd-7b-fp16-compatible variant on pool-2.
marta: dry-run shows prefixes clearing. command: ```/opt/tools/kvctl flush --node node-03 --model rwd-7b-q4 --prefixes=common_prompts```
marta: executing now...
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: kvctl flush completed on node-03 (duration 12s)
oncall-sre: confirming 500s dropped on node-03. tail latency improving.
kenji: rollback path is ready if latencies don't stabilize. scaling down q4 instances on pool-2 and shifting traffic to fp16 variant: ```kubectl set image deploy/inference-pool-2 inference=image:rwd-7b-fp16 -n inference-prod```
pm-ryan: how many customers affected? need to prepare impact note.
marta: preliminary: ~9 customers saw >1s extra latency, 2 customers had transient 503s for <5m. Will pull exact request IDs.
jee: (typo) sorry ignore jeb
jonah: creating a short list of impacted customer IDs in #support-ops, tagging CS.
eva: heads-up: I'm taking the handoff in 20m. can someone summarize mitigations for the oncoming shift?
oncall-sre: summary: detected spike in kv cache miss post quant rollout to rwd-7b-q4 -> flush prefixes on node-03 + shift traffic to fp16 variant -> latencies dropping -> monitoring for 15m before closing page.
eva: thanks. I'll monitor and run the post-incident follow-up if we stabilize. can we schedule a postmortem?
kenji: agree. propose postmortem: root cause candidate = quantization packaging changed prefix hashing; KV cache key mismatch -> cache misses -> increased compute and tail latency. need artifact to prove.
marta: action item: I will collect KV key histograms, cache hit/miss traces, and the rollout artifact. owner: marta. due: 48h.
jonah: action item: roll back quant packaging in CI to reproduce locally, create minimal repro on dev infra. owner: jonah. due: 72h.
kenji: action item: add a safety check in rollout pipeline to validate cache-key compatibility for quantized variants. owner: kenji. due: 1 week.
pm-ryan: I'll prepare the customer comms draft once we have confirmed impact numbers. owner: pm-ryan. due: 24h.
eva: I'll schedule the postmortem (30m) for next Tue 09:30 PST and create a doc. if that time doesn't work ping me with availability.
oncall-sre: closing the oncall page? conditions met: error-rate back to baseline for 9m, kv miss trending down.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident 'inference-runtime/pool-2 spike' marked resolved by oncall-sre at ts 2376543600
eva: handing over to night oncall in 10m. @oncall-sre leaving notes in the incident doc: mitigation timeline, commands run, metrics snapshots.
oncall-sre: notes saved: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/2376543210. key commands included in the doc.
marta: posting raw traces and `kvctl` output to the doc.
jonah: I'll link CI job logs and the quant packaging PR.
eva: for postmortem agenda: 1) timeline, 2) root-cause hypotheses + repro, 3) short-term remediation (safety checks + rollback guards), 4) longer-term (improve cache compatibility tests + model-variant contract), 5) owners + SLAs.
pm-ryan: request: include a short customer-facing timeline and exact affected tenant list in the doc.
kenji: I'll prototype a canary traffic policy to refuse quantized variants unless cache-compatibility tests pass. owner: kenji. due: 2 weeks.
marta: logging note: add KPIs to alerting: kv.cache.miss_rate > 0.25 AND 5xx_rate > 1% triggers page. owner: marta. due: 48h.
eva: ok all, I'll create the postmortem doc and calendar invite. tagging owners in the doc now. please add supporting artifacts before EOD tomorrow.
oncall-sre: handing off monitoring to @eva. good job team. :thumbsup:
pm-ryan: one more: I'll coordinate support follow-ups and share comms after we confirm exact list.
jonah: quick heads-up: reproduced locally with quant packaging mismatch; pushing logs to the doc.
eva: meeting scheduled: https://calendar.redwood/event/pm-postmortem-2376543210 (Tue 09:30 PST). attendees: eng-runtime, eng-oncall, ml-infra, product.
incident-bot: :information_source: Follow-up checklist created: [pm-ryan: draft comms], [marta: kv traces], [jonah: repro], [kenji: rollout guard], [marta: alert tuning]
km: (note) I'll ping infra to reserve extra capacity for canary tests.
end of thread.
